verdict.rationale: Gusto's official remote MCP server lets users query their own Gusto data in natural language through external AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, with OAuth and scoped access. The CLI also bundles agent skills, such as cash-forecasting, which projects upcoming payroll cash needs. However, all of these insights are delivered through third-party AI tools rather than natively inside the Gusto product, which is a significant caveat for this story. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or suggestions surfaced within the Gusto app UI, proactive AI recommendations from payroll/HR data, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
